per_credit_hour_charges.line: Dual credit courses cost just $75 per credit—about half of CSI’s regular tuition and much less than most colleges in Idaho. Students can save thousands of dollars while earning college credit before they graduate high school.
$75 per credit for a dual credit class taken at your high school.
So, at $75/credit, a typical 3-credit class costs $225.
$75 per credit for a dual credit class that you take at CSI.

Dual credit is $75 per credit - much cheaper than what you'll pay after you graduate high school. Many students use Idaho's Advanced Opportunities funds to cover some or all tuition. Books/fees may apply for some classes.
